# Jellutide (jellutide.onrender.com)

> Independent information and ordering website for Jellutide, a berry-flavored dietary supplement gummy for adults (30 gummies per bottle) taken before a meal as part of a healthy weight routine.

## Key facts
- Label: 525 mg proprietary blend of apple cider vinegar and BHB calcium, magnesium and sodium salts per gummy; 8 calories, 2 g sugars (1 g added); individual blend amounts are not disclosed
- Directions: one gummy before a meal
- Packs (USD): 2 bottles $79 each ($158 plus shipping); 3 bottles $69 each ($207, free US shipping); 6 bottles $49 each ($294, free US shipping)
- One-time purchase; 60-day money-back guarantee, subject to the terms shown at checkout
- Not a stand-alone weight-loss solution and not a treatment for any condition; adults only; contains sugar; ask a doctor first if taking insulin, diabetes, digoxin or water-pill medicine
